# The Kronos Library — books by P. I. Ford
> Eight volumes on the science, economics, and stakes of fusion energy, written alongside the Kronos Fusion Energy program.

/ (/books/): The Kronos Library index — all eight volumes with covers, subtitles, and format availability.

Volumes:
- The Fusion Energy Equations (2nd ed) — the physics of the Kronos machines
- The Isotope Economy — how fusion's neutrons will heal, fuel, and secure the world
- To the Moon for Fuel — the Helium-3 century
- The Machine That Controls the Machine — AI, digital twins, designing a star in silicon
- Energy Is Water — fusion, desalination, and the cities that drink the sea
- The Forty-Dollar Electron — firm power, data centers, and the new grid
- The Long Night — the century-long story of the fusion dream
- Energy, Sovereignty, and the End of Resource War — the geopolitics of abundant energy

Author: P. I. Ford. Publisher: Kronos Fusion Energy. Print / eBook / audiobook editions rolling out on Amazon KDP and Google Play.
